description: Call speaker.list first. If policy_upgrade_required is true, close speech and propose this operation with {}. The host must confirm it. Both policies come from the signed runtime, never your arguments. Existing usable speakers keep exactly their IDs, labels and recordings; an incomplete old enrollment is named and refused, not silently activated. A repeat after an uncertain publication verifies the same bytes without advancing the revision again. This never grants command authority.

session_id.description: Optional consistency check copied from speaker.list; normally omit for closed-microphone management.
